text:
andrea_p: Heads up — partners asked us to prioritize EU-West-3 and AP-SOUTHEAST-1 for the next region batch. They need capacity reservations + marketplace listing approvals. Can we confirm owners and a realistic ETA?

mike_partner: @andrea_p I'm on Azure marketplace side — Ravi (MSFT) said they can fast-track the listing once we have deployment manifests and KMS details. ETA depends on legal sign-off (certs).

lina_cloudops: For infra I'll need quotas bumped for GPUs in both regions. I've opened quota tickets with AWS (case 123456) and GCP (ticket 98765) — waiting on response. Estimated 5 business days if no follow-ups.

paul_sales: From partner success: we have two enterprise trials scheduled for EU customers week of 6/2, so having EU-West-3 available by then would be ideal. Is that feasible?

andrea_p: That timeline is tight but let's try. Action items: (1) Mike to share marketplace checklist and required artifacts; (2) Lina to escalate quota tickets and share approvals; (3) Sarah to confirm legal/compliance docs for marketplace. I'll loop in partner PMs.

mike_partner: Sharing checklist now: 
- deployment manifest (helm + overrides)
- privacy/data flow diagram
- KMS integration doc (HSM/KMS endpoints)
- SLA & support contact
- security attestation (SOC2 dev + prod)

mike_partner: Also note Azure will require a partner onboarding form (PDF) and a signed MSA addendum for private SKUs. Ravi can accept scanned PDF, but needs org-level billing contact.

lina_cloudops: Quota update: AWS replied — provisional increase approved for eu-west-3 to 160 vGPUs, pending capacity reservation request. GCP still pending. I filed a capacity reservation in AWS console (res-7890).

marketplace-bot: [automated] Marketplace validation started for package redwood-inference-0.9. Check logs: https://marketplace.example.com/validations/4421

paul_sales: I'll confirm billing contact and send to Mike. Also cc'ing the two customer trial owners to adjust expectations if needed.

sarah_legal: On legal side — we need a redacted data handling addendum for the marketplace listing and a copy of our export compliance checklist. I can review the vendor forms by EOD tomorrow if someone posts them here.

andrea_p: Great. Two potential blockers: (A) KMS endpoints for private customers in AP-SOUTHEAST — partners want region-specific HSM support; (B) quota delays on GCP. Lina, can you open a support escalation if GCP doesn't reply by EOD tomorrow?

lina_cloudops: Will do. I'll open escalation and ping our GCP TAM. If we can't get GCP quotas, fallback plan is to run ap-southeast tenants on nearby AP-SOUTH1 while we finish approvals, with routing via smart routing policy. We'll document latency impact.

mike_partner: Quick note on marketplace images: images must be signed and pass vulnerability scan. Build pipeline needs to attach SBOM. @andrea_p can devex add SBOM step to the CI?

andrea_p: I'll ask devex to add SBOM generation to the build. Also tagging this thread with the region rollout checklist.

paul_sales: For communications: once marketplace listing is approved and quotas reserved, partners want a joint announcement. Who is drafting the partner-facing messaging? I'll take draft and run it by marketing.

andrea_p: Paul you draft announcement, include expected capacity numbers and supported SKUs. Mike include partner logos and listing IDs. Sarah sign off legal. Lina include operational notes (SLOs, fallback).

marketplace-bot: [automated] Reminder: partner listing window closes in 7 days for next marketing cycle.

lina_cloudops: Update: GCP responded — they can provide the quota but need a project-level quota increase request and org justification. I've submitted that with perf numbers.

mike_partner: Ravi confirmed he can accept the PDF onboarding form today if we send it. I'll DM him the contact.

sarah_legal: I reviewed the partner form — minor edits to indemnity language, will push redline today.

andrea_p: Excellent. Next sync in 24 hours. Owners: Mike (marketplace artifacts), Lina (quotas & capacity), Sarah (legal), Paul (partner comms). I'll update the shared checklist: https://docs.internal/redwood/partner-region-rollouts/EU-AP-2026

paul_sales: Noted — I'll start drafting announcement and stakeholder list.

mike_partner: Sending Ravi the onboarding PDF now.

lina_cloudops: GCP quota escalated to Priority; estimated approval 48 hours. AWS capacity reserved.

andrea_p: Closing loop — if anyone hits blocker escalate to #release-war-room. Otherwise we'll aim for EU-West-3 go-live by 6/1 and AP-SOUTHEAST-1 by 6/8.

paul_sales: :thumbsup:
